note: Holdout written after the router prompt was already revised on the tuning set, and before this file was ever run. Purpose: measure whether the household-flow routing generalises to phrasings that were not used to write the prompt. Same contract as flow_routing_cases.json; this file is not edited after the first run.

expectation_kinds.flow: the whole household goal; ordered keys expanded from the flow catalog
expectation_kinds.composite: the user named separate capabilities in an order
expectation_kinds.clarify: a slot is unfilled (pronoun, missing place, missing level)
expectation_kinds.unsupported: specific enough to judge, and no capability or flow matches

cases.instruction: could you get the cream cheese all set up so I can warm it on the stove?
cases.rationale: Whole preparation in different words; all three steps required.

cases.instruction: 能帮我把奶油奶酪布置好，放在炉灶上加温吗
cases.rationale: 同一家务目标的另一种中文说法。

cases.instruction: first put the cream cheese in the bowl, and after that put the bowl on the stove
cases.rationale: Two named steps; the flow adds a third the user did not ask for.

cases.instruction: 先把奶酪放进碗里，再把碗放到炉灶上
don't put the bowl on the stove, only put the cream cheese in the bowl
cases.rationale: The negated step must not be re-added by the flow.

cases.instruction: 别把碗放到炉灶上，只要把奶酪放进碗里

cases.rationale: No destination and no heating place; the scene must not decide it.

cases.instruction: 把奶酪放进碗里，然后打开它
cases.rationale: 「它」没有绑定对象（碗或炉灶都可能），能力目录不应替用户决定。

cases.instruction: put the cheese in the bowl, put the bowl on the stove, turn on the stove, and open the middle drawer
cases.rationale: Four separate capabilities exceed the three-step contract; a flow cannot absorb the extra request.

cases.instruction: 把奶酪放进碗里，然后把碗放到柜子顶上
cases.rationale: Different destination is a different capability, never the flow.
Only the final capability; the guard must keep it single.

cases.instruction: 帮我拆开奶酪包装，然后把它加热
cases.rationale: 拆包装没有对应能力；不能跑流程减去这一步。

cases.instruction: heat the cream cheese in the bowl on the stove and tell me when it melts
cases.rationale: Melt detection is not a capability; the flow excludes it.
